purpose: Holdout coverage for DU-BENCH, kept separate from the development seeds that were already used to tune routing/selection rules. A sample is only holdout if it was NOT used to author rules or gold-fact iteration.
rules: Never mix a holdout sample's facts into rule design or threshold tuning.
Prefer existing local originals; never download and never fabricate a substitute.
A holdout document whose carrier the pipeline cannot take in is reported UNAVAILABLE with an acquisition request, not replaced by a synthetic document.
Record SHA-256 at bind time so a later content change becomes UNAVAILABLE rather than a silent pass.

the 972.3% loss increase is driven by a NON-CASH redemption-liability fair-value change
R&D expense (1,476.1M) EXCEEDS revenue (1,034.6M)
revenue +207.2% against cost of sales +203.0%, nearly identical rates

zero occurrences of non-GAAP in the whole filing, so any non-GAAP figure is fabricated
